endSummary: Uttar Pradesh opened their season with the most lopsided result of the round, beating Bihar by an innings and 267 runs in Rajgir. Madhav Kaushik's 150 and a Rinku Singh hundred built 540, and Bihar never got within 400 — bowled out for 141 and 132, with Kartik Yadav and Zeeshan Ansari taking four apiece.

endSummary: Baroda converted a 273-run first-innings lead into an innings-and-135-run win in Panaji, rolling Goa over for 138 in the follow-on on the final day.
